logic.EMA: alpha=2/(15+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed C[i-1]. Set desired-long only if C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND Q[i-1]>=1.1*mean(Q[i-41:i-1]) with positive reference mean AND float(C[i-1])>EMA15[i-1]*(1+entry_band). Price/quote reference ranges end i-2,exclude tested close/volume. All three conditions must hold on the same decision;no delayed arming. Quote volume is USDT turnover.
logic.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA15[i-1]*(1-exit_band),regardless of volume. Exit takes precedence;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/price or EMA equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never liquidates;volume threshold equality qualifies. Entry and exit bands are independent.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with 700USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

parameters.signal_initialization: Cash/desired-cash at OOS183;only prior completed bars;carry across all folds;no warmup trades.
parameters.volume_definition: Prior fully completed UTC day USDT quote turnover divided by Decimal28 arithmetic mean of precedingN completed quote volumes excluding tested day. >=threshold eligible;reference mean>0;entry filter only,exit unfiltered.
